nom: Mario Badescu Caffeine Eye Cream for Depuffing

avis.texte: I really do think I see this working, so I will continue to use it.
I still have eye bags. Only used one time and saw absolutely no change in the size of the eye bags.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy this again and I highly recommend it!
avis.texte: I bought this eye cream to help with bags I started having under my eyes. I never had issues with bags under my eyes till I started a new position at my place of work and had to start getting up very early for it. I just use this in the morning after my shower right before I do my makeup and it works amazingly well! By the time I get to work, no more bags under my eyes.

avis.titre: Nice moisturizer but does not de-puff under eyes as clai
avis.texte: Pros: a tiny amount of product goes a long way, it works well on my super-sensitive skin, moisturizes well Cons: after a month of daily use, my opinion is that it doesn't de-puff the under eye area at all. I even tried only applying under one eye a few times just to compare results. No difference! Also the jar design is misleading, inside has a false bottom so you're not getting as much product as the outer appearance of the jar might lead you to believe. Will I use this product up? Yes, because it does moisturize nicely. Would I buy it again? No, because it doesn't de-puff at all. And that's what I really want - a product to de-puff and firm my under eye area.
This makes my eyes burn, hurt and turn red. Unlike any otger of a dozen other eyes creams ive tried.

I have the MOST sensitive eyelids of anyone I know. Previously, I could only use Aquaphor on my eyelids. This eye cream is silky heaven for my eyes. However, I know a couple of people who say they can't use it because it burns their eyelids, which really surprised me! For me personally, it is the only eye cream that my eyelids have actually been able to stand. I cannot comment on the puffiness reduction because that is not an issue of mine.

avis.titre: This product does what I want it to do.
avis.texte: I am no longer a young person and this product continues to keep me from getting bags under my eyes. I have used it for years.
This is a nice, smooth, lightweight eye cream. I have very sensitive skin and it's perfect for providing a bit of cool moisture in the morning before applying my makeup.
At first it was great, I did see some change but after a couple of days it started to burn and sting. I stopped using it.
This is absolutely the best eye cream on the market. If you suffer with eye puffiness, this is the eye cream for you to use. Wouldn't use anything else!
This eye cream was not gentle enough to use on my face, let alone the delicate skin around my eyes. The intense burning and stinging this caused only stopped when i started using this on my hands.
This eye cream is my favorite, nightly eye cream! It is lightweight and you can feel it begon working as soon as applied. The affordable price is a bonus!
my eyes felt burning while ysing this eye cream. Notice it more when not wearing contacts. also , blurry vision.
As someone who suffers from under eye puffiness, I've tried alot of other products. This particular brand works for me without breaking the bank😉🥰
I use this every day and I love what it does to reduce puffiness under my eyes!

avis.titre: Burnt the top layer of skin
avis.texte: This does wake up your eyes, but it also burnt the top layer of skin next to my eye. At first it's very raw, then developed bumps from irritation, now left with a patchy dry spot and itching.

Caffeine seems to work for me I for me I got the caffeine eye patches , I saw a big difference so this why I purchased this item.,I've been using it for 5 days and I see tightness which is what I'm looking for . So I think it's good .
Within 2 days of using the eye cream in the morning my under eye bags disappeared. I have dry skin and it did not dry my eye area! Great price!
I generally can't tell the difference between most eye creams. This one is nice and light.
this product is one of my favorites. i love using it & have been for awhile now. i have very dark eye circles & it's helped tremendously!
I had some type of allergic reaction to using this. I've tried a lot of eye creams in the past but never this bad! Skin around my eyes was red, puffy, & flakey for a couple days after using.

I was looking for an eye cream that helps with my puffy, dry undereyes and Mario Badescu's Caffeine Eye Cream is it! I have tried them all - prestige and drug store, to no avail. It took a few weeks, but I am very impressed with the results! Puffiness has gone down significantly and my undereyes are smooth and moisturized. Concealer also glides on smoothly over this eye cream. I wish I would have found this eye cream sooner.....

I love this cream! It works well for me, no stinging, no skin irritation, no problems at all, just no more puffy eyes, especially in the morning! I use it twice a day: at night and in the morning before makeup, and I like that it dries and soaks into my skin and therefore doesn't make my makeup run. The only eye cream that has truly done for me what they said it would do.

avis.titre: Could be good? But my skin doesnt like it
avis.texte: Ive tried it two times now. The first time it left a very light rash with small bumps on both sides of my face, the second time it made my under eyes burn. It could be good? My skin wont give it a chance. After reading some other reviews i see other people had the same problem with it.
My eyes burned every time I've tried it and dried out my skin.

avis.titre: Love this for everyday! Not so great from a caffeine product
avis.texte: This product is great for a light weight eye cream. More gel like. Didn't see a big change from caffeine but liked it well enough to buy another jar.
Used am + pm, for 2 months. No change in under eye puffiness. Sz of container is deceptive-false bottom.
My eye area where I had applied the cream turned red, then I woke up with extremely puffy eyes. I've never experienced this with any eye product before.

avis.titre: Product is okay, but will come almost empty
avis.texte: This product isn't sealed properly. If you buy it in the store, it's half full (maybe a bit over). If you get it shipped, you mind as well consider it a sample size because it was barely a quarter of the way full and kinda chunky. Gross…

I was using the Chamomile Eye Cream (which worked just fine), but was excited to try this for the caffeine benefits. Mistake. Not only have I not seen any benefits, but this stuff is so thin and watery- it's not moisturizing at all, and I feel like I'm damaging the skin around my eyes more because it takes so much effort to work it in. Very disappointed in this purchase. (I'm also a bit confused by the many positive reviews...but glad it worked for someone, as this was a complete waste of money for me.)

I wanted to try this product so I ordered it and when I received it. I had tried it and yes theirs a little tingling but not much. After the second maybe third day of using it. My eyes started to hurt so I believe I had a reaction to this product. Had to return it, didn't get to see results.

I have bags and dark circles under my eyes, and have tried SO MANY different eye creams. I have to say, this is one of the best I've ever used. It addressed both of my problems immediately. It has a gel like consistency, and sinks into the skin instead of sitting on top of it. Very impressed with this cream! I would certainly purchase again.

I really feel this has made my under eyes so much lighter than how dark they were. AND my eyes look so much more awake and pretty. But.... when I opened the product half on the cream was all piled up on one side and the other part is empty... Weird.

I bought this eye cream because of the reviews and have to say it doesn't disappoint. A little goes a long way which will make the product last. The texture and feel underneath the eyes is so nice and moisturizing.

I had ordered this product due to I couldn't wait to try it due to the good reviews. But once I tried it I had an allergic reaction to it. My eyes were hurting and I started to get a headache. As much as I wanted to see results sadly I wasn't able too.

avis.titre: Wow - impressed on how fast this works.
avis.texte: The skin around my eyes is much more even. No dark, puffy spots. Very impressed.

avis.titre: Definitely my new go to eye cream
avis.texte: I use this every day twice a day. I put it on an hour ago and you can still feel it working. It does have a cooling sensation and you can feel it tighten the skin under your eye.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy again but think it will last a while.
avis.texte: This new eye cream is the best thing in Mario's line! I can wear it during the day without a tissue constantly in hand! No weeping!!! It also feels like 'tightening' after a few seconds of putting it on. I think I will stop 'experimenting' with so many different eye creams and only buy this onw.

I've tried other caffeine eye creams and serums, and this one is by far my favorite. I love Mario Badescu products and couldn't wait to try this eye cream. I use it every morning and sometimes mid-day when I'm feeling tired. It's more of a cooling sensation than a tingling for me. It's very refreshing, and a little goes a long way.
